debt_context.summary: Pressured seller without formal distress: AHT's 10-Q (Aug 12, 2026) states substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern and names hotel sales as a source of cash. The Oct 1 closing 8-K says about $41.2M went to the lender on a seven-hotel loan; v1 has no category for proceeds to a lender unless the sale was lender-negotiated, which isn't stated.

also_sources.label: AHT 8-K (Oct 1, 2026): ~$41.2M paid to the mortgage lender

debt_context.summary: Documented trigger at announcement: the Oct 1, 2026 8-K says about $41.2M of the ~$43.5M price was paid to the mortgage lender. Scored at the v1 lender-negotiated band (2); v1.1 doesn't say which band a trigger takes.
